name: mirage
text: I can't recover more live-game orders from GitHub. The engine's order ledger (trades.json) only holds Nov 4 onward and is carried job to job; no older copy of it is in the archives. The Releases hold socket recordings and scan journals, not a record of orders. So the 2 live-game orders (1 win, 1 loss, net -$0.66) are all I can prove. If you remember more, they were probably placed by a different path: the phone's live lane or your own taps, which show in your Novig history and the Tracker tab, not the engine ledger. Tell me roughly when, or what they looked like, and I'll find them in the phone-data bets.
